messages:
emily: Heads-up: proposing a soft unpin of runtime v3.1 for a short canary to validate the new quantized model bundle (gptq-v5). Target window: tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Low-risk, but want ops eyes.

raj: What are the known compatibility touchpoints? SDK bump? handler changes?

emily: No SDK breaking changes in the SDK itself, but the runtime switches kernel selection for int4 paths. We do need the SDK shim flag enabled for 24h to avoid older SDKs triggering fallback.

oliver: @emily also need to confirm autoscaler behavior under the new runtime when batch sizes drop (we saw a surge last canary). Can you add a queue stress test?

emily: Added a short stress job to CI. /cc @tess for QA prompt set.

ci-bot: CI job #8765 started: runtime-canary-stress-test (parallel=4). Logs: https://ci.internal/8765

tess: Quick note — our eval harness found a 0.6% token-distribution drift on a handful of long-sequence prompts with gptq-v5. Probably fine but worth watching. I attached sample prompts in the ticket.

maya: This is fine from PM side as long as we have rollback criteria defined (latency > +30ms p50 or drift > 1.0% for critical prompts).

raj: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Canary on 5% of traffic in us-west for 30m, 2) monitor error rate, latency, and the QA prompt diff, 3) if green, bump to 25% for 45m, then full. Rollback on any of: 5xx increase > 0.5%, p95 latency +100ms, or QA drift > 1.0%.

emily: Sounds good. I'll draft a short runbook and add the SDK shim flag to the canary config: `runtime.experimental_enable_sdk_shim=true`.

oliver: Also ensure deploy-bot has the rollback playbook entry. If canary health fails, auto-roll back to runtime v3.0.7.

deploy-bot: [deploy request queued] user=emily, target=runtime v3.1-canary, fraction=5%, region=us-west, window=2026-03-21T02:00:00Z-03:00:00Z. Approvals: required=1, approved=0.

emily: Approving now. Approver: emily.

deploy-bot: [approved] by emily. Starting canary deploy.

ci-bot: Canary stress job #8765 completed: 3/4 tails passed. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/8765

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 5% (stable), health OK, p50 +12ms, p95 +18ms, 5xx unchanged.

tess: QA diff watchers: small drift on 2 prompts only, not in critical set. Marking as observed.

oliver: Observability note: traced a slight increase in kernel stalls on long seqs, added a temporary alert: `kernel_stall_rate > 0.02` on canary nodes.

maya: Given the data and the rollback criteria, I vote to proceed to 25% after the next 45m.

raj: Agree. emily, once you hit 25% please paste the deploy-bot status here.

emily: Pushing to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: scaled to 25% traffic. Health: degraded=false. p50 +25ms, p95 +40ms, 5xx delta +0.1%. QA drift cumulative 0.7%.

oliver: Still within thresholds but keep an eye on p95 — we want that < +100ms.

tess: I'll run an extra QA sweep with the full prompt set.

ci-bot: Synthetic load replay started against canary pool (duration=20m).

deploy-bot: Canary health stable. No auto-rollback triggered.

emily: Given stability, proceeding to full roll forward over next 2 hours in waves. Posting release note blurb to #announcements after completion.

maya: Post-rollout ask: include a short note about the SDK shim and the recommended SDK upgrade timeline (48h).

oliver: After full rollout we'll watch autoscaler metrics for 24h; set a temporary policy to keep min replicas +1 in peak windows.

deploy-bot: Rollforward started: waves scheduled [us-west, eu-west, ap-south]. ETA full: 2h.

deploy-bot: Rollforward progress: eu-west completed, ap-south completed, us-west finalizing.

deploy-bot: Rollforward complete: runtime v3.1 rolled out to 100%.

emily: Release note: "runtime v3.1: int4 kernel improvements + support for gptq-v5 quantized bundles. Note: enablement of SDK shim recommended for 48h. See internal RFC: https://docs.internal/runtime/v3-1"

maya: I'll file the follow-up ticket for SDK adoption metrics and notify key customers.

raj: Postmortem checklist: capture any anomalies, attach CI artifacts, record QA diff and canary logs.

oliver: Minor follow-up: two autoscaler events in ap-south during rollforward — marked as transient. Will monitor.

emily: Closing the thread. Thanks all :party_parrot:
